items.title: Google Cloud launches 'Gemini agent', a universal enterprise work agent that can route to Claude
items.summary: At Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud unveiled the Gemini agent, a single agent for knowledge work, media creation and coding that works across Gemini Enterprise, Workspace, Slack, Microsoft 365, the command line and mobile. It picks a model per task, starting with Gemini and Claude, and can spawn temporary job-specific sub-agents; teams can also create 'coworker' agents with their own mailbox, calendar and Drive. An API exposes it as a headless agent. It is in private preview, with wide availability for select Workspace Business and Enterprise plans promised 'soon'.
items.why_it_matters: Google is consolidating its enterprise agent products into one surface and openly orchestrating a rival's model, raising the stakes against OpenAI's always-on dots agents and Microsoft's Copilot.

items.title: Samsung guides Q3 operating profit to a record 107.4 trillion won on ~195T won sales
items.summary: Samsung Electronics' preliminary Q3 2026 results put operating profit at about 107.4 trillion won (~$80B), its first quarter above 100 trillion won, on sales of about 195 trillion won. Operating profit rose roughly 20% from Q2 and 782% year on year, a 55.1% margin, and beat a consensus near 106 trillion won while sales came in slightly below the ~199T consensus. The figures are preliminary; the full division breakdown is due Oct 29. Seoul shares slipped on the day and the KOSPI fell, while SK hynix rose.
items.why_it_matters: It confirms the memory upcycle is still accelerating through Q3 and sets the bar for SK hynix and Micron prints later this month; the muted share reaction suggests the good news was already priced in.

items.title: Microsoft and Nvidia launch Surface Laptop Ultra on RTX Spark with OS-level controls for local AI agents
items.summary: At an Oct 7 event, Microsoft and Nvidia launched the 15-inch Surface Laptop Ultra built on Nvidia's RTX Spark chip, with preorders open. items.why_it_matters: It pushes sandboxed always-on agents onto mainstream Windows hardware and puts Nvidia into PC silicon against Apple and Qualcomm.

items.title: South Korea orders probe as AI is suspected in hacks of seven banks exposing about 68,000 people
items.original_title: 韩国多家银行被黑，疑似有人工智能参与，李在明要求彻查
items.summary: President Lee Jae-myung told an Oct 6 cabinet meeting there are signs AI was used in recent attacks on Korean banks and ordered a thorough investigation. The Financial Services Commission puts the affected number at over 68,000 people across institutions including Shinhan (about 25,000 customers), KB Kookmin and Hana. Police formed a dedicated team; attribution to a Chinese-developed AI tool is reported but not confirmed by Korean authorities.
items.why_it_matters: It is a concrete government-level acknowledgement of AI-assisted attacks on financial infrastructure, adding to the agent-misuse enforcement wave.

items.title: Nvidia commits $1B over five years to US science at White House Genesis Mission event

items.title: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission: free OSS Scanner and a critical-infrastructure defense program with 11 partners
items.summary: Anthropic announced two programs: the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program, giving operational-technology security providers frontier Claude models and engineers with eleven founding partners (including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Deloitte and Rockwell Automation), and a free, opt-in OSS Scanner that periodically scans enrolled open-source projects and sends findings with proof of concept and suggested fix, without human review. Anthropic expects a true-positive rate above 90%.
items.why_it_matters: It turns Project Glasswing-style vulnerability discovery into a standing free service; unreviewed reports shift triage onto maintainers, so report quality will be the test.

items.title: Anthropic commits $150M over three years to the Genesis Mission, extending Claude to 15+ federal agencies
items.summary: At the White House OSTP science summit on Oct 8, Anthropic pledged $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, making Claude available to more than 15 agencies including NASA, NIH and NSF. It will provide Claude, Claude Code and API credits to several hundred research projects and partner with national labs on fusion and quantum work.
items.why_it_matters: It deepens Anthropic's federal footprint at a time when the Pentagon has said it stopped using Claude.

items.title: Ant International's agent protocol links 10 e-wallets and 7 acquirers with Visa and Mastercard trust frameworks
items.original_title: 全球最大智能体支付协同网络在上海启动，AI让银行卡与电子钱包统一语言
items.summary: Shanghai-based Ant International said its Agent Mobile Protocol (AMP) has connected its first 10 mainstream e-wallets and 7 leading acquirers, covering 1.5 billion users, and aligned trust frameworks with Mastercard and Visa so bank cards and wallets can interoperate in agent commerce. Users who pre-bind payment tools in agents such as Doubao could let the agent pay without redirects. UnionPay has a competing agent-payment framework (APOP).
items.why_it_matters: Agent payments standards are fragmenting between Ant and UnionPay, and whoever wins decides how Chinese consumer agents transact.

items.title: Anthropic rewrites usage policy with weapons, surveillance and robotics limits, effective Nov 12
items.summary: Anthropic's 2026 Usage Policy update bars weapons-related software and components and arming drones or autonomous vehicles, prohibits tracking people without consent, and says Claude may not decide whom to investigate, arrest or charge. Claude connected to hardware must be observable and stoppable by a qualified operator and hold a safe state if disconnected. The elections section is narrowed, and the supported-regions rule now covers entities headquartered in or majority-owned from unsupported regions.
items.why_it_matters: It sets contractual limits for agentic and robotic builders and government customers, amid the dispute over Claude's military-use restrictions.
